notes.title: Kyubu Kyubu Dice development is going Steady!
notes.notes:
Since I'm a solo game developer I often overlook these types of discussion/news features. I think I will use this more often from now on.

I just wanted to mention that the development of Kyubu Kyubu Dice is going fine and steady. I'm quite excited to be honest.

Please take a look at the VN style dialogue system I've been working on, it's got a text log and everything lol. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854852/ec11d8c8ed2c249e3e6d547ea1a8349e4fff8d2d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854852/94e5e79bd134cfe25d141fdbb57a64740be1bd07.png[/img]

I'm really looking forward to this.

Plus here the last artwork I did of the main girls:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854852/ea840f588227edfc216a506f8ea5635e7d251765.png[/img]
From left to right: Camilla, Teresa and Alba.

You are the best, stay awesome.
